title.narrative: Festival Awawale 2026: Vivre ensemble dans la diversité 6e édition

description.narrative:
The NGO GROMO is an Ivorian LGBTQI+ organisation founded on Monday 26 March 2018 in Côte d’Ivoire, in the capital Abidjan, with its headquarters in Angré in the municipality of Cocody.
Their mission campaigns for the defence of LGBTQI+ rights, fights against HIV/AIDS within the LGBTQI+ community and focuses on the economic empowerment of LGBTQI+ people (notably through the promotion of entrepreneurship), which is an essential step towards full empowerment and social acceptance.
The objectives of the activity are: ?To defend the human rights of LGBTQI+ people in Ivorian society ?Combat diseases, particularly HIV/AIDS and STIs ?Promote the financial empowerment of LGBTQI+ people: - On the one hand, by supporting entrepreneurship through co-funding income-generating activities and the creation of SMEs by LGBTQI+ people - On the other hand, by facilitating access to employment for LGBTQI+ graduates.
The Awawalé Festival is a socio-cultural event promoting social cohesion organised by the LGBTQI+ organisation NGO GROMO. It promotes the skills of LGBTQI+ people and their social inclusion through raising awareness of issues affecting this community (HIV/AIDS, human rights, LGBTQI+ entrepreneurship and socio-religious factors): LGBT+ resilience and advocacy for living together in diversity.
The event will take place in June 2026. It relates to 17 May, the International Day Against Homophobia and Transphobia. Just like previous editions, this sixth edition is centred on the theme of living together in diversity. The aim is to call on society at large to show tolerance towards LGBTQI+ people, to combat discrimination and stigmatisation against LGBTQI+ people, and to promote social inclusion. This year, there will be 5 programmes and 1 Awawalé Tour, which are: ?The LGBTQI+ Visibility Conference ?Awawalé Awards: Awards ceremony honouring those who promote human rights and living together in harmony ? The Careers Exhibition ?Screening of LGBTQI+ short films ?The concert: Together against prejudice.
